title: The cylinder on a simplicial object is contractible over the object
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file simplicial.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-contractible at source lines 4830-4844, three statements about the cylinder U times the standard 1-simplex: the projection composed with either of the two end inclusions is the identity, and the identity of the cylinder is homotopic both to the composite through the first end inclusion and to the composite through the second. The proof at source lines 4846-4871 has to write down the homotopies explicitly. It uses the description of the relevant maps supplied by the author's lemma on the pair (U, the standard 1-simplex), defines in each degree a map into the next degree of the cylinder by a formula involving the maximum of the simplex coordinates, verifies the face and degeneracy identities that make it a homotopy, and then notes that the same construction with the minimum instead of the maximum gives the second homotopy. The first statement is a componentwise computation with the same description. The statement lists the conclusions and none of the formulas. No cross-chapter result is invoked inside the retained span.
